source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The hub footer skips release notes for NIGHTLY_BUILD, a missing app.releaseNotesURL preference or an about:blank result. It formats the configured URL, assigns the anchor and unhides its list item only after these checks. This is a product/channel condition, not a generic rule that every build has release notes. Current source retains it. No Daily, beta or release footer was opened.
title: Only show release notes when the configured product build has them
